description: The shipped meeting-notes window may run one local meeting flow: check readiness, request the two capture permissions, start and stop a meeting, name a meeting, edit an operator note, copy a transcript, correct a displayed speaker name without rewriting the retained transcript, restore a verified withheld transcript turn without rewriting the source artifact, open only the verified transcript file the operator selected, release a selected recording, delete a confirmed transcript and its generated notes, delete a confirmed meeting, open local completed notes with retained source passages, and regenerate a meeting note from its current transcript. It cannot use generic filesystem, shell, process, dialog, remote-origin, account, or cloud authority.
